pages.quiz:
INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word joins two ideas that contrast? (1 mark)
   A. so
   B. because
   C. and
   D. but

2. What does an oral text mean? (1 mark)
   A. A text drawn on paper
   B. A text that is spoken
   C. A text written on a wall
   D. A text printed only

3. Which order is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Go to school, wake up, wash, eat
   B. Wake up, wash, eat breakfast, go to school
   C. Wash, go, wake up, eat
   D. Eat, go, wash, wake up

4. What should the title of an instruction chart do? (1 mark)
   A. Give a joke
   B. Tell what the task is
   C. Be blank
   D. Hide the task

5. Where can you check the meaning of a word? (1 mark)
   A. On a shoe
   B. In a simple dictionary
   C. In a bag
   D. On a clock

6. Which is a good way to check a proverb's meaning? (1 mark)
   A. Ask an elder or teacher
   B. Ignore it
   C. Cover it
   D. Guess forever

7. Where can a class publish its final paragraphs? (1 mark)
   A. Under a bed
   B. In a school or class magazine
   C. In the dustbin
   D. On a stone

8. What is a stanza? (1 mark)
   A. The title
   B. A rhyme only
   C. A group of lines in a poem
   D. A single word

9. Which words show the order of steps? (1 mark)
   A. first, then, next
   B. mother, father
   C. sun, rain
   D. red, blue, green

10. Which of these words is a noun? (1 mark)
   A. tasty
   B. slowly
   C. boil
   D. millet

11. Which is a wild animal? (1 mark)
   A. Zebra
   B. Dog
   C. Cow
   D. Hen

12. What does a peer review checklist help with? (1 mark)
   A. Cleaning the room
   B. Checking a partner's story kindly
   C. Stealing ideas
   D. Ending the lesson

13. What should you do after writing a dialogue? (1 mark)
   A. Hide it
   B. Read it aloud with a partner
   C. Tear it
   D. Never look at it

14. Which is the first step in writing a dialogue? (1 mark)
   A. Choose the theme and characters
   B. Draw the border
   C. Sign it
   D. Write the ending only

15. Which of these is an action verb? (1 mark)
   A. lead
   B. the
   C. very
   D. is

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give two rules for filling in a form correctly. (2 marks)

17. Create a form with four fields to find out classmates' favourite games. Include a title and instructions. (4 marks)

18. Explain how the position game is played with objects on a table. (4 marks)

19. Add capital letters, commas and full stops: on friday we bought rice beans and flour (3 marks)

20. Explain what an instruction chart is. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — but
   But shows contrast.

2. B — A text that is spoken
   Oral means spoken.

3. B — Wake up, wash, eat breakfast, go to school
   This is the natural order of a morning routine.

4. B — Tell what the task is
   The title names the task.

5. B — In a simple dictionary
   Dictionaries give meanings.

6. A — Ask an elder or teacher
   Elders can explain the meaning.

7. B — In a school or class magazine
   Publishing shares the writing.

8. C — A group of lines in a poem
   A stanza is a group of lines.

9. A — first, then, next
   Sequence words show the order.

10. D — millet
   Millet is a grain, so it names a thing. The others are an action, a describing word and an adverb.

11. A — Zebra
   Zebras live freely on the plains.

12. B — Checking a partner's story kindly
   Peer review helps improve writing.

13. B — Read it aloud with a partner
   Reading aloud shows if it sounds natural.

14. A — Choose the theme and characters
   Planning comes first.

15. A — lead
   Lead shows action.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Read instructions first, write neatly inside the spaces, give true information, sign and date it (any two).
   Working / marking points: One mark for each.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Title: Favourite Games. Instructions: Write neatly. Fields: Name, Class, Favourite game, Date.
   Working / marking points: One mark for title, one for instructions, two for four fields.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: One pupil gives an instruction such as put the pencil on the book. Another follows it. The class checks whether the position is correct. Then the roles are swapped.
   Working / marking points: One mark for each of four points.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: On Friday we bought rice, beans and flour.
   Working / marking points: One mark for capitals, one mark for the commas, one for the full stop.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: An instruction chart is a poster that shows the steps of a task in order using short words and often pictures.
   Working / marking points: One mark for steps in order and one for a poster or pictures.
